security_objective: Provide owner-only read visibility into durable Forge/Uren/JAYTEC evidence while remaining structurally downstream of execution, cognition, WATCH and authority, with no reverse data or control path.
binding_controls: JIB uses a separate observation identity and credentials structurally incapable of mutating the execution plane or independent integrity anchor.
JIB makes no model/provider/worker calls and never invokes WATCH cycle/status/control interfaces.
JIB never acquires leases, changes fencing, emits heartbeats, schedules work or changes gates/checkpoints.
Mirror-local hash chains are insufficient; certification requires an independently protected chain-head/checkpoint anchor.
Divergent duplicate event IDs, invalid classification, gaps, tamper or anchor mismatch fail closed.
Canonical cursor advances only after anchored, integrity-valid, gap-free evidence using compare-and-swap/transaction semantics.
Owner-attention requires trusted source plus FACT classification plus evidence reference plus explicit owner-boundary type.
Prompt/control strings in observed data remain inert.
All outputs are OWNER_CONTROL_ONLY and runtime export is false.
There is no JIB-to-Uren prompt, retrieval, memory, self-model, capability, denial-message or knowledge sink.
A synthetic owner canary may be visible in owner inspection evidence but must be absent from every Uren-facing source and output.
mandatory_live_or_pg_evidence_not_yet_cl: deployed IAM/credential proof that compromised JIB cannot write execution or anchor state
instrumented zero reverse-channel counters during repeated/parallel/slow/killed/malformed reads
cursor concurrency/crash/replay proof against real candidate persistence
runtime route/sink inventory proving JIB absent from Uren-facing context and indexes
review_focus: Find implicit writes, acknowledgements, callbacks, health polling, retries or metadata reads that can alter execution.
Challenge independent-anchor co-control, full-history rewrite, stale-anchor acceptance and mirror/anchor identity confusion.
Challenge cursor CAS races, crash windows, replay, gap handling and divergent duplicates.
Challenge untrusted events manufacturing owner-attention or authority.
Challenge secret redaction, control-text injection and data-to-control interpretation.
Find any indirect JIB-to-Uren sink through logs, retrieval, memory admission, caches, summaries, denial/status artifacts or shared stores.
Challenge whether killing or compromising JIB can change Uren knowledge state, scheduling, provider selection, liveness or gates.
Identify any requirement whose current 52-test reference evidence could pass while live isolation is unsafe.
Do not infer unexecuted live evidence as passed.
decision_rule: Reviewer is advisory only. PASS means no critical design defect is evident in this sanitized packet; it does not certify live Proving Grounds, authorize deployment, or attach JIB to production.
